input.request: Build Kit Return, a returnable-equipment deposit page. Token name: Kit Return. Token symbol: KIT. The fixed total supply is 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals (1,000,000,000 * 10^18 base units), minted once to the deployer. KitReturn lets an owner register a bytes32 kit hash and deposit amount, a borrower lock that deposit to take custody, and the owner confirm return to refund the borrower; the borrower can reclaim if the owner does not confirm within exactly 7 days after the borrower marks returned. Deploy on Sepolia and publish a page to register kits, borrow, mark return and settle deposits.
input.context: Sepolia only (chainId 11155111); GitHub and IPFS are approved. Include Foundry tests and an independent adversarial review. Constructors use only address, uint256, bool or bytes32 arguments; the launch token constructor is zero-argument. foundry.toml must set bytecode_hash = "none". No proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct. Owners and borrowers each submit the transaction that protects their kit or deposit; deadline rights are called by the party with funds at risk.

draft.objective: Build and review KIT and KitReturn, deploy them on Sepolia, then publish the live equipment-return website.

steps.objective: Implement fixed-supply KIT and the returnable-kit deposit workflow.
Test custody, authorization, return windows, refunds, and frozen terminal states.
Independently adversarially review all kit and deposit transitions.
Build the live kit registration, borrowing and return page.
